content: Tsomba tse'i sefaccone ti'tsse canjaen'cho attiansi gi atte. Pushesu tsu attian. Coejechigama ondiccupa cose'suchiganga ccutsu. Tise tsovenga doce o'feve otifacho.
Tsa pushesuja suripa du'shuma isuye tson'jen. Isuye tson'jemba aiye'jepa fundo'je.

Tise fundosi faesu canjaen'cho tsu sefaccone attian. Ñoa'me rande cu'a canjansiaca'on tsu attian. Tsa canjansija siete tsoveve an'biamba diez ontsian'ccove tsu an'bian. Poi siete tsove tsu na'su otifaccuma otifacho.
Atse'fai'ccu sefacconi'su o'fema fae tercera enttingeccoeyi bui indipa andenga ttova shequian. Tsomba tsu canjansija pushesunga catsepa ronda'je du'shuma isusi tse'faei'ccuyi cundeye.

Tsa'ma pushesuja tsandie du'shuve isusi tse'faei'ccuyi du'shuma Chigani angasi Chiga dyaipa'cho jini can'jen. Du'shuja poi ande'su goviernoma mandaya. Nane yoshava'ccoi'ccu mandaqquia'caen tsu quia'me mandaya.
Tsonsi pushesuja a'i menia ccuyapa, mil dosiento sesenta a'tave a'tupa can'jen. Chigaja tise can'jeña'chove ñoña cuintsu pushesuja tseni aña'choma an'biamba ñotsse can'jeñe.

Tse'i sefacconi geraencco'fa. Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'su na'su, Miguel, tisema shondo'su sundarondeccui'ccu canjansima geraen'fa. Canjansi'qque tisema shondo'su sundarondeccui'ccu poini ccane'qque geraencco'fa.
Tsa'ma canjansija oshambisi tisema patsupa Chiga sefaccone joqquitssian'fa.

Tsa'caen tsa rande canjansi, tsa cocoya na'su, Satana, qquen inisecho'cho, andenga catiyesi tisema shondosundeccu'qque andenga catiye'fa. Nane canjansi tsu tayopi'su iyo'ca'en a'ima qqueña'su. Toya tsu can'jen poiyi'ccoma qqueñañe.
Tsonsi gi sefaccone afa'choma paña. Quia'me afapa tsu su:

content.text: Chiganga ccutsupa pa'cco a'ta, pa'cco cose'qque ingi faengasundeccuma afase.

content: Tsa'caen cocoya na'su Satana andenga ttova catiyepa tisu catiye'chove atesupa canjansive attiamba tsa tsandie du'shuve isu'cho pushesuma indiye omboen.

Tsa'ma pushesunga tsu dos pindo sanccopa'ca'ma afe cuintsu tsai'ccu chhajepa tise a'i menia can'jeñani ccuyin jaye. Tseni tsu tise'be ñoña'fa cuintsu tres canqque'fa faesu canqque'fa enttingeve tseni an can'jeñe. Tseni jasi cocoya canjansija tisenga catseye oshambi.
Canjansija catseye oshambipa tise aya'fa'ye na'en'ca'en coeñamba ja osha'ta pushesuma tise can'jene cashi somboeñe.
Tsa'ma ande tsu pushesuma fuite. Nane aya'fa sharuqquia'caen andeja fettayepa canjansi aya'fa'ye sombopa ja'je'cho na'ema cu'i.

Tsa'caen cu'isi canjansija ñoa'me pushesuma iyicca'ye. Iyicca'yepa ja pushesumbe faesu dushundeccui'ccu iyiccoye. Pushesumbe faesu dushundeccuja poiyi'cco Chiga manda'choma pañamba tsonsundeccu tsu. Nane Jesúsve in'jamba canse'chondeccu tsu.
Tsonsi cocoya na'suja mar'su sisipandunduni japa ccui.
